questions.question: What kind of cursed corpse did Masamichi Yaga create in the past?
questions.subject: Masamichi Yaga/Synopsis

answer.item: Panda, an abrupt-mutation cursed corpse that was sentient and could produce its own cursed energy

questions.question: Why was Yaga imprisoned after creating Panda?
questions.subject: Masamichi Yaga/Synopsis

answer.item: he was imprisoned on orders from the higher-ups, who considered designating him as special grade and imposing an indefinite restraint on him since Yaga's potential ability to create independent cursed corpse army posed a threat to jujutsu society

questions.question: What mission did Yaga assign to Gojo and Geto?
questions.subject: Masamichi Yaga/Synopsis

answer.item: the mission to escort the Star Plasma Vessel Riko Amanai back to Jujutsu High so she could merge with Tengen

questions.question: What was Yaga doing on the night of December 24th during the Cursed Child Arc?
questions.subject: Masamichi Yaga/Synopsis

answer.item: Yaga was in Shinjuku, fighting at the frontlines and directing other sorcerers

questions.question: Why did Yaga disqualify Yuji during his interview?
questions.subject: Masamichi Yaga/Synopsis

answer.item: When Yuji answered that he wanted to help people per his grandfather's last request, Yaga was not satisfied with the answer and disqualified him.

questions.question: Why did Yaga punish Gojo on the first day of the Goodwill Event?
questions.subject: Masamichi Yaga/Synopsis

answer.item: Yaga punished Gojo for his obnoxious attitude

questions.question: What punishment did the jujutsu headquarters give Yaga after the Shibuya Incident?
questions.subject: Masamichi Yaga/Synopsis

answer.item: jujutsu headquarters gave Yaga the death penalty for inciting his former students, Satoru Gojo and Suguru Geto into causing the incident

questions.question: Why did a sorcerer and Gakuganji fight Yaga in the Culling Game?
questions.subject: Masamichi Yaga/Synopsis

answer.item: The sorcerer informed him that he was given the death sentence, but could be spared if he told them how to make independent cursed corpses. After Yaga refused the offer, the sorcerer fought him along with Gakuganji, defeating and heavily wounding him.

questions.question: Why didn't Yaga reveal how to make cursed corpses earlier to save his life?
questions.subject: Masamichi Yaga/Synopsis

answer.item: his final words were meant to be a curse from him to Gakugaji before passing away

questions.question: What did Gojo shout at Yaga in the afterlife?
questions.subject: Masamichi Yaga/Synopsis

answer.item: shouted at him that he died without regrets, contrary to what Yaga said to Yuji during the interview
